episodes.summary: During a merciless winter epidemic ten years ago, a younger, idealistic Vane investigated the sudden deaths of three wardens at the east-side charity hospital; Thorne, the only physician who stayed on night shift, signed the death certificates as rapid pneumonia, and Vane trusted and publicly defended him without a moment's doubt.

believed_summaries.char_vane: The three wardens died of rapid pneumonia, as certified by the devoted Dr. Thorne.

metadata.setting: east-side charity hospital, cramped drafty office
metadata.era_detail: grey slush, coal smoke, fever, tallow candles, carbolic acid
metadata.present_frame: Vane reinterprets the memory in the Mahogany Study after the toxicology report
